DIMENSIONS FOR SPLIT PIN HOLES, WIRE HOLES 
AND HEAD SLOTS FOR BOLTS 



1. Scope — Covers the dimensions for split pin holes and wire holes for bolts, screws and slots for 
hexagon and square head bolts and screws. 

Note — The symbol for wire holes and head slots may be included in the designation of the fasteners in the 
respective product standards when required. 

2. Dimensions and Tolerances 

2.1 The dimensions for location and diameter of split pin holes shall be as given in Table 1, dimen- 
sions of wire holes as in Table 2, and dimensions of slots in hexagon and square heads as in Table 3.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistance has been derived from the following 
publications: 

ISO/TC 2-N688-1978 Bolts and screws — Split pin holes, wire holes, slots for hexagon and 
square heads. International Organization for Standardization. 

DIN/962-1975 Schrauben und Mutter Nzusatzlich Formen und Ausfuhrungen Bestellangaben 
und MaBe ( Screws, studs and nuts; types with additional delivery details ). Deutsches Institut fiir 
Normung ( DIN ).
